description: Linux kernel for H96 Pro Plus (Amlogic S912/GXM): the ACTIVE series in application order, plus the status of every other file in kernel/patches. Applied by build/prepare-kernel.sh.

active.origin: linux-media mailing list, HEVC series v3 (2023-03-14, not merged upstream)

active.note: the maintainer's two EOS/drain commits on top of HEVC (correct EOS/drain sequencing; EOS padding tuning via module params)
tracked-file state of kernel build #77 relative to the step-3 result: folds the early vdec, Panfrost (0021), IR, watchdog and PM hooks as they stood on 2026-09-08
the #77 snapshot contains 0024, but the #80..#112 line did not: #96 and #102 were 'base + 0024' candidates that were never installed
comment-only: one line of 0025's comment as it stood in the built tree; makes vdec.c byte-identical to the maintainer's #81 commit
canonical PM driver; its Kconfig/Makefile hooks come from step 4
the DTS of builds #77..#112 (sha256 e84b56b7...); compiles to the DTB installed on the maintainer's unit (26f81f59...); the dtb Makefile line comes from step 4
savedefconfig of the #112 .config (sha256 1070eb3f...); regenerates that .config byte for byte

verification.steps_1_to_4: byte-exact: after step 3 the git blob hashes of all 19 files touched later equal the pre-image hashes recorded in the #77 snapshot; after step 4 all 19 post-image hashes match
verification.after_step_8: byte-exact against the maintainer's local commit 124a496af ('kernel #81 exactly as built'): every file the series has touched by then is identical (blob hashes)
verification.final: byte-exact against the source hashes recorded in boot111r.manifest (kernel build #112, the last documented running baseline): all 30 source files listed there, the DTS and the .config; the only listed file not reproduced is meson-vdec.mod.c, a build-generated file
verification.dtb: the DTS compiles to sha256 26f81f595d10487f92674e681f9809a763a7aed3d66ba4ff09f6d30205a3ffc9, the DTB written to both reserved records on the maintainer's unit
verification.checked_on: 2026-10-10, against the maintainer's build tree mounted read-only

builds.#81: #80 + CONFIG_PARTITION_ADVANCED + CONFIG_CMDLINE_PARTITION; committed by the maintainer as 124a496af = this series up to step 8

builds.#113: #112 + AVC experiment knobs (0045 vdec1_hz, 0047 h264_vendor_init, 0048 vdec1_mcrcc_reset) - experimental image boot113r, not a baseline; these knobs were never published as patch files

not_applied.note: early vdec work; its state at #77 is in the snapshot
Bluetooth options; covered by the defconfig

mouse mode moved to the userspace daemon device/h96proplus/h96mouse; the kernel code is still in meson-ir.c (hardware NEC handler) but is not reached: the board matches meson-gxbb-ir and uses the software decoder
replaced by the canonical meson_gx_pm driver

the only vdec.c change of the #77 snapshot

research for AVC corruption, not a fix
